Problem Statement:
Create a Base Employee class and an Engineer subclass to calculate salary.
1. Employee (Base class) has attributes: name, id, basicSalary.
2. Engineer (Derived class) has bonus and calculates total salary as basicSalary + bonus. 
Input Description:
1. String name
2. Integer id
3. Integer basicSalary
4. Integer bonus 
Output Description:
Print total salary. 
Sample Input:
John 101 50000 7000 
Sample Output:
57000
